name: superwebpros
description: SuperWebPros team skills and plugins for Claude Code and other Agent Skills-compatible tools.

plugins.name: director-kit
plugins.description: Direct AI video like a real director — turn a plain idea or a written story into a continuity-locked, character-consistent short (story, ad, reel, or trailer). Pipeline: brief -> assets -> shot list + continuity ledger -> storyboard -> animate. Auto-generates via the fal connector where available (Claude Code); otherwise produces ready-to-paste prompts.

plugins.name: incident-response
plugins.description: Run a fleet-wide security or ops incident with AI agents safely: read-only blast-radius audit, beads epic with built-in verify + cleanup, delegation contracts, reversible change ritual (backup, rollback tag, canary, soak), human approval gates, an independent verifier, and tracked teardown.

plugins.name: edit-kit
plugins.description: Post-production for talking-head video. Non-destructive cleanup steps from raw footage to a reviewable cut. Requires the private superwebpros/compound-remotion repo for the Remotion/Lambda render.

plugins.name: msu-course
plugins.description: Run MSU SSC 490-005 (AI Workflows & Organizational Intelligence) like a client project: plan sessions and milestone sprints as outcome/steering plans with a calendar sync pass, capture post-class retrospectives that push concrete edits into downstream plans, and write student-facing session docs, milestone docs, step examples and team templates.
